source: Architect's drawing set 'SON BEDROOM-Binder1.pdf', sheet FX-0001 'DOSTI MEZZO 16TH FLOOR', dated 20.05.2026 (kept outside the repository). Values marked derived were measured from the drawing's own scale, not read from a dimension string.

bays.text: three bays, each dimensioned 2'-11" (bottom row), each labelled "2 SHUTTER OPENABLE"; plan page 1: "WARDROBE=9'0"RFT"

drawerStripM.text: "FOOTWEAR DRAWER" strip under each bay, dimension 7" (right side stack)

baseGapM.text: 2" at the foot of the right-side dimension stack

heightM.text: right-side stack 2" + 7" + 7'-7" = 8'-4" = 100" = 2.54 m, under the 8'-6" ceiling; a further 2" to the ceiling is implied by 8'-6" - 8'-4"; the topmost dimension text of the stack is overprinted ("2" / 6"") and could not be read

sources.frontColor: drawing fill colour of the shutters, sampled from the rendered page (#E3D5C8 to #E7DBCF, a light beige gradient); derived
sources.handleYM: derived: bar centre 39" above the floor, from the drawing's scale (7.2 px per inch on the 7'-7" shutter height)
sources.handleLenM: derived: bar length about 10" by the same scale

internal.text: open shelf at the top, lockable drawers, three glass drawers, hanging space with folded shirts, footwear drawer: read but not built, the shutters do not open in the viewer

surfaceHeightM.text: 1'-8" from the floor to the top of the "6"MATTRESS" band

heightM.text: 1'-8" to the mattress top + 1'-10" headboard rise above it = 3'-6" = 1.0668 m

sources.baseTopM: derived: mattress is 6" thick ("6"MATTRESS"), so the bed base is 1'-8" - 6" = 14" = 0.3556 m high

sources.heightM: derived: ELEVATION-4 (page 6) draws the side table top level with the mattress top (1'-8" = 0.508 m); there is no dimension string for it

width.text: 1'-2" wide, both sides of the bed. The layout's box for this item is not changed

position.text: swivel chair symbol (no label) on the room side of the STUDY 2'0"X4'0" table, centre about 1 ft from the table edge, about the middle of its 4' length
